name: iarda
description: IARDA brand system, report exporters and Warehouse Management & Inventory Control System (WMS).

scripts.samples: node reports/cli.js reports/examples/camps-report.json --lang ar --out docs/samples && node reports/cli.js reports/examples/camps-report.json --lang en --out docs/samples
scripts.build: npm -w @iarda/shared run build && npm -w @iarda/web run build && npm -w @iarda/api run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @iarda/api run typecheck && npm -w @iarda/web run typecheck
